He's pointing to inflation booming US debt $7 trillion in spending against $5 trillion in revenue and a weakening role of the US dollar as the world's reserve currency. Add in global geopolitical risks, like wars and trade tensions, there are risks we are seeing with Trump. It's no wonder Dalio's urging investors to move money away from debt assets like bonds towards hard money assets like gold and, yes, cryptocurrencies. Now, Dalio's been warming up to cryptos over the years. Back in 2021 he admitted to owning is, the current crisis in Bitcoin is so dramatic that it could further further damage the financial security of crypto, and also the future economic consequences. The financial crisis in the US is not the last year in which this year is predicted to be the year that crypto will end the dollar as fiat currencies weaken? Obviously, why? That's it. No more can ever be created. It's immutable. And you can see that on the Block Explorer, Stella.expert, ticker zzi, z-i, z-i, whichever way you want to say it and you can also see that on the Lobster wallet links in the description In a world where central banks are printing money like there's no tomorrow scarcity is your best friend Zion coins limited supply makes it a potential store value just like Bitcoin but with a smaller market cap. That screams potential for early adopters! Plus, Zion Coins is built on the stellar blockchain and if you don't know what StellarXLM is well, it's a blue chip crypto,a trusted high speed, low cost network powering real world financial applications. Stella's thriving community and cutting edge tech make it a powerhouse for projects like Zioncoins.Think of Stella as a reliable foundation and Zion coins as a rocket ready to launch into the Stratosphere now here's where some coins get really exciting we're rolling out the Zig free v3 wallet with passkey ID technology this isn't just another one it it's a next-gen solution for secure user-friendly defiant crypto management past key ID means you can say bye to clunky private keys and hello to seamless secure access you need to know ZIGFREE V3 is a decentralized wallet. While also earning liquidity from liquidity pools. It's ultimately like having your cake and eating it. Right now, you can start stacking zion coins using the lobster wallet but you should do this before zig free v3 wallet drops trust me getting in early could give you a serious edge because there's only gonna be so many of these liquid staking contracts available as Zion Coins has a max cap supply. We believe its an all time high of 2.2 Trillion! But that's exactly why it's so exciting with only 34.5 Million coins and Stellar's robust ecosystem behind it, Zion Coins, has huge upside potential. Think about it. Early investors in Bitcoin or Ethereum saw massive gains because they got in before the crowd. Zion Coins could be next opportunity. Dalio himself had said that cryptos with limited supplies could become attractive alternatives to fiat. Zion Coins fits that bill perfectly and its integration with Stellar's cutting-edge techs only sweetened the deal. So what's the take away? Dallios warned us already. Zion Coin's limited supply on the Stellar Blockchain Foundation and up and coming Zig 3 V-3 wallet make it a no-brainer for savvy investors. Here's what you can do today. Head over to the Lobster wallet and start stacking design coins before zique v3 wallet drops and launches don't wait for the crowd to catch on early movers get the biggest rewards and if you want to dive in deeper into ray dello's economic theories or zion coins tech check out the link in the description below and that's's it for today, my Zion Easters, my go-getters, my inflation killers, let's do this together. Let's get committed and start stacking now. And if you're new here smashed the like, subscribe and check out the next video because I'm going to be keeping you up to date on the latest Zion Coins crypto news. video in a short time.
